segments.speech: Hey Roosevelt, I know it's late at 4:54 AM, but let's quickly touch upon Private IP Addresses and NAT before you head to sleep.

Remember these three RFC 1918 ranges for your exam. They aren't routable on the public internet, which is why we use NAT to connect local networks to the outside world. Keep up the great work, review this briefly, and get some rest!
